topic: mesh peer discovery for sovereign agents

phase1.assumption: Centralized coordination is essential for reliable mesh peer discovery in sovereign agent networks.
phase1.inversion: Decentralized, peer-to-peer discovery mechanisms are sufficient for reliable mesh peer discovery in sovereign agent networks.

predictions.threshold: Decentralized methods reduce latency by ≥40% compared to centralized approaches in large-scale networks.
Decentralized systems maintain ≥95% connectivity during simulated node failures, while centralized systems drop to ≤80%.
Decentralized discovery scales to ≥10,000 nodes without performance degradation, whereas centralized methods fail at ≤5,000 nodes.
